items.title: How Hathr.AI delivers multi-tenant agentic RAG for regulated US government workloads with Amazon S3 Vectors
items.summary: Hathr.AI runs a HIPAA-aligned, multi-tenant agentic RAG tool for regulated industries in AWS GovCloud (US). This post covers its architecture (a Step Functions ingestion pipeline, per-customer Amazon S3 Vectors indexes, and Strands Agents on ECS Fargate) and the results after moving vector search from Amazon DocumentDB to Amazon S3 Vectors.
items.creator: Sam Hart
